summary: Completed backend smoke + frontend stress/regression validation for rapid-click and pointer-lock scenarios using seeded authenticated user with 120 inventory skins.

integration_issues.issue: `yarn test src/components/SkinsSection.test.jsx` fails before running tests: Jest cannot resolve `react-router-dom` from `src/lib/i18n.js`.
`PointerEventsGuard.test.jsx` bounded-recovery test fails in jsdom (body pointer lock remains `none` in synthetic mutation scenario), while browser stress run recovered correctly.

issues: Element-level right>innerWidth+1 offenders detected mostly inside horizontally scrollable live-drop strip, but page-level overflow check passed (`documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth`).

action_items: Fix Jest resolution/config so `react-router-dom` imports work in component tests (currently blocks SkinsSection regression suite).
Revisit PointerEventsGuard regression harness (or guard behavior) to make bounded recovery verifiable in unit tests under fake timers/mutation observers.
Optionally refine overflow scanner to ignore elements inside intentional horizontal scrollers to reduce false positives.
critical_code_review_comments: `/app/backend/server.py` is a very large monolith (>700 lines guideline). Split into smaller route/service modules to reduce regression risk and improve maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created dedicated user `discord_it1_rapid_100hz` with 120 skins, balance 250000, 25 drops; JWT added to /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright stress achieved ~155.8 dispatched+observed clicks/sec for 25s with 0 post-burst normal-click failures and pointer lock recovery verified in browser (settings/topup/listbox). Desktop overflow count 0; mobile page-level overflow false. Main unresolved blockers are frontend test infrastructure (`react-router-dom` in Jest) and one failing synthetic PointerEventsGuard unit case.
rca of the issue: 1) SkinsSection test blocker: Jest runtime cannot resolve `react-router-dom` import chain from `src/lib/i18n.js`, so suite aborts before assertions. 2) Pointer guard unit failure: synthetic fake-timer+jsdom mutation path did not clear `body.style.pointerEvents` in bounded test despite browser E2E recovering; likely mismatch between jsdom observer/timer behavior and real browser mutation scheduling, or insufficiently deterministic trigger in test harness.
